theWhy: We’re back at it today with another full-body burner—but don’t worry, we’re easing in with intention, not intensity overload. This workout builds on the last one, gently stepping things up as you get more familiar with these foundational moves.\u000A\u000AWe’re still rolling with that upper-lower-body combo approach (aka Peripheral Heart Action training). It keeps your heart rate humming, your muscles working, and your time well spent.\u000A\u000AYou’ll hit your glutes, arms, core, and those sneaky inner and outer thighs that help you stay steady and supported in real life—think stairs, groceries, or just living your best boss-lady life.\u000A\u000ARemember: it’s not about perfect reps or pushing through pain. This is your workout. Pause when you need to. Breathe. Modify. Celebrate every little win. You’re building strength in all the ways that matter most.
